newsitem.title: USA: Valley Natl sets 2-mln-shr offer at $8/shr.
newsitem.headline: Valley Natl sets 2-mln-shr offer at $8/shr.

text.p: Valley National Gases Inc on Thursday announced a public offering of 2.0 million shares of its common stock at a price of $8.00 per share.

The company is selling 1,918,000 of the shares being offered, which represents about 21 percent of the shares outstanding after the offering. The net proceeds from the offering will be about $13.7 million.
Valley National Gases is a leading packager and distributor of industrial, medical and specialty gases, welding equipment and supplies, and propane.
A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc is the managing underwriter for the offering and the co-manager is Oppenheimer & Co Inc.
The rest of the shares will be sold by other selling shareholders: officers and director for tax purposes.
